supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: significant lateral extension beyond the outer corner of the eye

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: marked contrast between high-intensity (pale) muzzle region and low-intensity (dark) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: thick vertical 2D profile with visible structural droop and white pigmentation

other_distinctive_markers: pronounced depigmentation across the lower lip and chin boundary
